about: The web push payload each subscribed device is sent, before encryption (refactor plan step S10). The override run sets OPENV_PUSH_NOTIFICATION_TYPES to exactly the types the default allow-list leaves out.

deliveries.scenario: agentrun.finished, failed, launched by a member

sends.payload: {"title":"Agent run failed","body":"An agent run you launched finished with an error.","url":"/projects/proj-apollo/agent-runs?run=run-42","tag":"run_failed:run-42"}

deliveries.scenario: agentrun.finished, failed, a run with no project launched by a member

sends.payload: {"title":"Agent run failed","body":"An agent run you launched finished with an error.","url":"/org/runs?run=run-44","tag":"run_failed:run-44"}
